scientific_integrity: The joint completion-count formula is attributed to established nonuniform quota enumeration, not presented as new. The full-parameter ordering is proved using log-concavity of convolution and a strictly positive Toeplitz minor. Exact rational state dynamic programming provides independent finite checks, not proof for all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Independent identically distributed draws, finite set of required types with strictly positive fixed probabilities, common positive integer quota, optional null outcomes. Heterogeneous quotas, time-dependent rates and dependent draws are not covered. Prior counting formula is known; novelty is strictly conditional likelihood-ratio dependence; broad historical priority is not certified.
title: Rarity ordering of the terminal type in equal-quota coupon collection
